overall: Violations found on three counts: no pre-session roll call (cured on the spot), failure to state executive session subjects, and an insufficiently specific notice. Council ordered to comply going forward.

allegations.summary: Council entered executive session on Jan 13 after a unanimous voice vote, not a recorded roll call vote.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by failing take a roll call vote prior to entering into its January 13 executive session

allegations.summary: Council President announced only 'pending litigation and litigation strategy' before entering executive session, without naming the specific matters.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to state all subjects that could have been revealed without compromising the purpose for which the January 13 executive session was called.

allegations.summary: The Jan 13 meeting notice did not list the executive session purpose or specific litigation matters, and its wording suggested open-session topics.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to disclose in the meeting notice for the January 13 meeting all executive session subjects that could have been revealed without compromising the purpose for which the January 13 executive session was called.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (for the notice and executive session announcement violations).
Council may not continue to withhold the January 13 executive session minutes under the Open Meeting Law (may still withhold under other exemptions).
remedy_passage: we order the Council's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Council that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
